project: MINERVA QCELL P&ID - Colour-Line-First Engineering Process Model

description: Wave roadmap for decomposing the real QCELL/RFCELL P&ID SVGs into colour-defined process lines, preserving sequence and scope boundaries.

waves.name: Source Ingestion & Style Extraction
waves.expected_output: data/svg/*.svg copied from real sources; element/colour/style extraction with correct inline-style precedence

waves.name: Layer / Mechanical-Section Engine
waves.expected_output: Per-section (QM / Jumper / QVB / QINFRA) layer assignment for every colour line

waves.name: Geometry, Arrow Tracing & Sequential Ordering
waves.expected_output: arrows_detected + sequential_components per line (currently DEFERRED_W004 placeholders)

waves.name: Tag & Instrument Register Reconciliation (XLSX coverage delta)
waves.expected_output: Reconcile the 297 auto-catalogued components against the official tag/instrument register (XLSX); report coverage delta (matched / false-positive / missing) + nomenclature reconciliation; cross-validate colour-derived line identity against ISA tag class (configs/isa_classes.json)
waves.note: Swapped to first position per engineering review — this is the question a reviewer asks first. Interactive viewer moved to W006. [W005 delivered: 0 exact-tag overlap is a real finding — design & as-drawn schemes orthogonal; coverage reported per TYPE. See reports/W005_XLSX_RECONCILIATION_REPORT.md]

waves.name: Interactive Layered Viewer
waves.expected_output: Interactive layered viewer beyond static atlas HTML: layer toggling, colour-line isolation, click-through component inspection

waves.name: CI Workflow + Cross-Drawing / Temperature Annotation
waves.expected_output: CI (GitHub Actions) running ./make.sh + tests on push; cross-drawing QCELL<->RFCELL identity reconciliation; 4.5 K / 2 K / warm classification per segment

waves.name: Round-Trip Reassembly
waves.expected_output: Recompose isolated colour lines back into the full P&ID without loss of meaning
